desc: Resume access across the organization for up to 1,000 frontline members. Success means the request was queued, not that all updates have completed.

token.desc: Authentication token bearing required scopes. Tokens should be passed as an HTTP Authorization header or alternatively, as a POST parameter.

user_ids.desc: IDs of frontline members in the authenticated organization. Valid users are queued; rejected IDs are returned in invalid_users.

reason.desc: Optional explanation for the access change.

invalid_users.desc: Rejected users. An empty array on success; populated in failed_for_all_users and failed_for_some_users error responses.

restricted_action.desc: Only organization admins and owners can perform this action.

failed_job_enqueue.desc: The access change could not be queued. Retry the request.

failed_for_all_users.desc: No valid users were found. Nothing was queued. invalid_users lists the rejected IDs and reasons.

failed_for_some_users.desc: Valid users were queued, but some users were rejected. invalid_users lists the rejected IDs and reasons. Correct and retry only those IDs.

success.description: All users were queued. Updates have not necessarily completed.

error.description: The valid user was queued, but another user was rejected. Correct and retry only the rejected ID.
